contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Providentiae Caess issue of 324-330, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate draped left. Obverse inscription: [--]ANTIVS[--]. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers, door open, star above. Reverse inscription: [PROVIDEN] TIA C[AESS]. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 1.55gms, die axis: 6
